page.layout: One printed page, rotated on the scan. Upper part: a faint title in large letters at the top. Centre: a faint rectangular ruled frame, possibly an engraving or a stamped box. Right edge: an oval library stamp, not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan is rotated about 90 degrees and the print is very faint, so the title lines could not be read. The central rectangle is a faint frame, not readable text. The oval library stamp at the right edge and the dark book binding at the left are not transcribed. Show-through from the other side may be among the faint marks.
